explanation: Indonesians typically beckon with a downward motion of the hand or fingers, rather than curling a single raised index finger toward themselves as is common in Western countries. A single-finger beckon can come across as impolite or overly commanding, similar to norms in several neighboring Southeast Asian countries. Using the whole hand, palm down, is the safer, more familiar gesture.
local_tip: Beckon with your whole hand, palm facing down, in a scratching or waving motion toward yourself, rather than curling a single finger.

also_check.note: Finger-beckoning is considered rude and used mainly for animals; the whole hand, palm down, is used instead.
Finger-beckoning is considered highly offensive; a palm-down hand gesture is used instead.
Finger-beckoning is common and generally acceptable in casual settings.
